xmldoc.short_description: Hessenberg form of a square matrix.

param_output_item.param_description: upper Hessenberg matrix similar to A.
unitary transformation matrix satisfying A = P * H * P'.

description.p: hess reduces a square numeric matrix to upper Hessenberg form by unitary similarity transformations.
With two outputs, hess also returns the accumulated transformation matrix P such that A = P * H * P'.

example_item.example_item_description: Compute a Hessenberg form and verify the similarity residual.
